tools.name: search_doctors
tools.description: Search doctors listed on Dr. AI Hub (draihub.com) by specialty and/or city in Egypt. Returns name, specialty, city, clinic, address, fee in EGP, clinic hours, rating and the profile URL where a patient books for free. Arabic or English words both work (e.g. "dentist", "طب الأسنان", "Sohag", "سوهاج")

tools.name: get_doctor
tools.description: The public profile of one doctor listed on Dr. AI Hub, by the id from search_doctors: specialty, city, clinic, address, fee, hours, languages, experience, rating, about text and the booking page URL.

tools.name: list_specialties
tools.description: Every medical specialty a doctor can list under on Dr. AI Hub, in English and Arabic, with what each one treats.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: Egyptian cities that have a "best doctors" page on Dr. AI Hub, with English and Arabic names, governorate and page URL.

tools.name: search_health_topics
tools.description: Find Dr. AI Hub pages about a health condition or a medicine (including Egyptian brand names such as Panadol). Returns names and page URLs; use get_health_topic for the content.

tools.name: get_health_topic
tools.description: The content of one Dr. AI Hub condition page (symptoms, causes, treatment, when to go to the emergency room, which doctor to see) or medicine page (uses, side effects, warnings, brand names in Egypt). General information, no doses.

tools.name: about_dr_ai_hub
tools.description: What Dr. AI Hub is, the main links for patients, and how a doctor lists themselves for free.
